Experience matters

Your tile showroom in south west Sydney

Bonnyrigg Tiles supplies quality tiles for residential and commercial projects across Sydney and the surrounding areas, and has been under current management since 2017. Whether you are updating one bathroom or supplying a large development, we carry stylish, durable tiles to suit your design and your budget.

Our team works with homeowners, builders and designers every day, so you get practical advice on tile selection, design ideas and installation from people who know the product.

We are a tile shop in Sydney's south west, with one showroom in Bonnyrigg, NSW. From it we supply tiles Sydney wide, with pick-up from the showroom or delivery across Sydney metro.

Read more about Bonnyrigg Tiles.

Read our story

Finish the room

Bathroomware, tapware and kitchen sinks under one roof

Bonnyrigg Tiles is a tile store in Sydney that also sells bathroomware, tapware and kitchen sinks, so the whole room can go on one enquiry. Choose the tile first, then add the vanity, basin, bath, toilet, mirror and tapware that suit it.

You will find everything for the bathroom, from vanities and baths to floor wastes and grates. Browse the tapware section for basin mixers, wall mixers, spouts and showers, and our kitchen products for kitchen sinks and kitchen mixers. Where a product shows Enquire Now, our team confirms the price and availability when you send your enquiry.

For the trade

Trade supplies for tilers and builders

Tilers and builders can pick up tile adhesive, grout, waterproofing, silicone, sand and cement, trims and tools from Bonnyrigg Tiles, with the showroom open from 7am Monday to Saturday. As tile suppliers to Sydney tilers and builders, we keep the tiles and everything needed to lay them under one roof.

Head to the trade section for brands such as Sika, Davco, Laticrete, Aqua Mix and Soudal. Add what the job needs to the same enquiry as your tiles, or call (02) 8786 0288 to check stock before you drive over.

Visit us

The Bonnyrigg tile showroom

Colour and texture are hard to judge on a screen. Come in to explore the latest tile trends, compare finishes side by side and book in your free colour consultation.

Ours is the tile showroom Sydney homeowners, tilers and builders visit to compare finishes side by side. If you are comparing tile shops in Sydney, come in and see the tiles in person before you decide.

Good to know

Questions we hear in the showroom

Can't see your question here? Call us on (02) 8786 0288 and our team will help.

View all FAQs
Where is the Bonnyrigg Tiles showroom and when is it open?

Our showroom is in Bonnyrigg, in Sydney's south west. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturday from 7am to 3pm. We are closed on Sundays.

How do I order tiles from the website?

Add the tiles and products you are interested in to your enquiry cart, then send them through as a single enquiry with your details. No payment is taken online. Our team will get back to you to confirm availability and final pricing.

What are BT Specials?

BT Specials are the tiles Bonnyrigg Tiles imports directly, together with our clearance lines. You can browse the full range on the BT Specials page or see them in person at the showroom.

Can I see a tile in a room before I visit?

Yes. Our tile visualiser lays the tile across a bathroom, kitchen or alfresco floor so you can compare sizes, layouts and grout colours. Screens vary, so we still recommend seeing your shortlist in the showroom before you order.

Do you deliver tiles in Sydney?

Yes, we offer Sydney metro delivery. Include your suburb when you send your enquiry and our team will confirm delivery to your area. You are also welcome to collect from the showroom, and our vehicle loading policy explains how collection and loading work.

Do you sell more than tiles?

We do. Alongside floor and wall tiles we stock bathroom ware, tapware and kitchen sinks, plus tiling tools and trade supplies such as tile adhesive, grout, waterproofing, sand and cement.

Where is the Bonnyrigg Tiles showroom and when is it open?

Our showroom is in Bonnyrigg, in Sydney's south west. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturday from 7am to 3pm. We are closed on Sundays.

How do I order tiles from the website?

Add the tiles and products you are interested in to your enquiry cart, then send them through as a single enquiry with your details. No payment is taken online. Our team will get back to you to confirm availability and final pricing.

What are BT Specials?

BT Specials are the tiles Bonnyrigg Tiles imports directly, together with our clearance lines. You can browse the full range on the BT Specials page or see them in person at the showroom.

Can I see a tile in a room before I visit?

Yes. Our tile visualiser lays the tile across a bathroom, kitchen or alfresco floor so you can compare sizes, layouts and grout colours. Screens vary, so we still recommend seeing your shortlist in the showroom before you order.

Do you deliver tiles in Sydney?

Yes, we offer Sydney metro delivery. Include your suburb when you send your enquiry and our team will confirm delivery to your area. You are also welcome to collect from the showroom, and our vehicle loading policy explains how collection and loading work.

Do you sell more than tiles?

We do. Alongside floor and wall tiles we stock bathroom ware, tapware and kitchen sinks, plus tiling tools and trade supplies such as tile adhesive, grout, waterproofing, sand and cement.
